fr_html: Rappelant ensuite la part importante que Lord Pauncefote a prise à l'établissement de la Cour d'Arbitrage, le Baron Descamps remarque que le résultat des travaux de cette Cour est fort honorable: elle a examiné un nombre assez considérable de cas, à la satisfaction générale.
en_html: After recalling the important part which Lord Pauncefote has taken in establishing the Court of Arbitration, Baron Descamps pointed out that the results achieved by this Court were very creditable; it has examined a considerable number of cases to the satisfaction of all concerned.
